identity.title: [v0.92.1][DRT-03] Run Wuji three-voter multi-agent production proof

values.task_boundary: Implement only DRT-03 within its exact owned paths and authority boundary.
deliverables: Exact-revision production launch and scenario runner.
Node, agent, authority, quorum, commit, lease, snapshot, Observatory, resource, replay, and cleanup receipts for every phase.
acceptance_criteria: The exact #142 merge SHA is ancestral to the tested revision and its retained Guardian/API/WSS/WP-04.16 proof passes.
Three independently started voters commit governed work; two voters preserve quorum; one voter cannot mutate.
The old Observatory lease expires before successor binding and stale-owner writes are denied.
Snapshot restore, voter restart, agent continuity, replay, and cleanup pass without shared state roots or direct executor bypass.
non_goals: Testing an open or merely green #142 PR
Using in-process service objects as voters
